text:
maria_csm: kicking off Cedarwell Health onboarding — they want Redwood Private in their AWS account for PHI workloads. target: 7 weeks. owners: Maria (CSM), Lee (SE), Tasha (Ops), Mina (Enablement), Jorge (Program). confirm?

maria_csm: success criteria: private endpoints + VPC tests green; SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning; PHI schema mapping signed off; runbook + 2 trainings delivered; pilot latency p50 <300ms for 95%.

lee_se: Ill own integration and test harness. need sample payloads and SAML metadata from Jorges PM contact. will deliver checklist by next Thu.

tasha_ops: Ill own infra: VPC peering, security groups, certs. Q: pilot RPS?

maria_csm: customer expects light pilot ~30 RPS, steady ~150 RPS.

mina_enable: enablement will run one dev workshop + one ops runbook review, record session and produce quickstart.

jorge_pm: Ill drive timeline and stakeholder comms. propose: W0 kickoff; W1 infra; W2 integration; W3 internal tests; W4 pilot 10% traffic for 48h; W5 iterate; W7 go-live + 30d check.

tasha_ops: flag: if customer manages KMS/certs timeline can shift 4-6 business days. also need SOC2/BAA requests early.

maria_csm: risks noted. actions: Maria request SAML + sample payloads by Tue; Lee integration checklist by Thu; Tasha infra checklist by Wed; Mina training dates by Fri; Jorge to publish project board.

maria_csm: @onboardbot schedule 45m kickoff Tue 10am PT and post invite here.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 10:00 AM PT  45m  "Cedarwell Health  Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/cedarwell (invites sent).

lee_se: will block time.

mina_enable: Ill draft agenda and sample slide deck."
